question: What kind of recipient, tested over a fixed period, is alone eligible to receive a particular teaching according to this obligation?
premises: A particular thing is marked as something that must be given.
The intended recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for the course of one year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one who was previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The identity of the thing to be given is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
